name: Direct my own learning
statement: I can take ownership of my learning by connecting it to what matters to me and the world around me, knowing how I think and learn, and adjusting how I work as I go.

name: Connect what I'm learning to what matters to me
statement: I can connect what I'm learning to my interests, goals, and the world around me.

name: Understand how I learn and how I think
statement: I can recognize how I learn best and how I think, and use that to guide my learning.

name: Plan and manage my time, attention, and work
statement: I can plan my work, manage my time and attention, and follow through.

name: Monitor my progress and adjust my strategies
statement: I can monitor my progress as I work and adjust my strategies to stay on track.

name: Seek and use feedback to grow
statement: I can seek feedback from others and use it to improve.

name: Persist with purpose and adapt with confidence
statement: I can understand myself, care for my well-being, take healthy risks, and persist through challenge and change in pursuit of what matters most to me.

name: Know my values and aspirations
statement: I can name my values, aspirations, and what matters most to me.

name: Care for my well-being
statement: I can take care of my physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

name: Manage my emotions, stress, and impulses
statement: I can recognize and manage my emotions, stress, and impulses.

name: Navigate challenges and adapt through change
statement: I can persevere through difficulty and adapt as circumstances change.

name: Communicate Ideas
statement: I can shape and share ideas, emotions, and information clearly and effectively across audiences, contexts, and forms of expression.

name: Choose and introduce my message
statement: I can identify my purpose, audience, and message, and introduce it clearly.

name: Convey ideas in writing
statement: I can write clearly and effectively for my purpose and audience.

name: Present to an audience
statement: I can present with focus, clarity, and impact to an audience.

name: Communicate visually
statement: I can communicate visually with clarity and impact.

name: Craft stories
statement: I can craft stories with arc and detail to build connection or communicate ideas.

name: Engage in Dialogue and Advocacy
statement: I can listen actively, engage with empathy across cultures and perspectives, and advocate for myself and others with respect and impact.

name: Engage in discussion
statement: I can listen with full presence and contribute meaningfully to discussion.

name: Navigate difficult conversations with honesty and care
statement: I can stay engaged in difficult conversations with honesty and care.

name: Advocate for myself and articulate my own needs
statement: I can articulate my needs, goals, and boundaries and advocate for myself.

name: Advocate for others
statement: I can recognize when others are not being heard and advocate for them.

name: Collaborate effectively on teams
statement: I can contribute my strengths, build inclusive teams, navigate disagreement, check in on progress, and help my team produce work no one of us could do alone.

name: Establish shared purpose, norms, and roles
statement: I can help establish shared purpose, norms, and roles on a team.

name: Navigate conflicts and challenges productively
statement: I can navigate conflicts and challenges productively.

name: Monitor progress and share accountability
statement: I can track my team's progress and share accountability.

name: Reflect on our collaboration
statement: I can reflect on how my team worked together and how to improve.

name: Build relationships, networks, and strengthen community
statement: I can foster belonging, build and draw on networks, take action, and engage in the communities I am part of to make them stronger.

name: Foster belonging
statement: I can foster belonging and welcome others into a community.

name: Build and draw on my network
statement: I can build and draw on a network of people and resources.

name: Take action to improve my community
statement: I can take action to improve my community.

name: Build and engage in healthy online communities
statement: I can build and engage in healthy online communities.

name: Think Critically
statement: I can ask good questions, evaluate information and arguments, weigh perspectives, and improve my own reasoning to reach sound, well-supported conclusions.

name: Ask questions
statement: I can ask questions that guide my thinking and inquiry.

name: Find and evaluate information
statement: I can find relevant information and evaluate whether to trust it.

name: Analyze and evaluate media
statement: I can analyze and evaluate media, including a creator's purpose and how it tries to persuade me.

name: Interpret and synthesize information, data, and representations
statement: I can interpret and synthesize information, data, and representations to make meaning.

name: Evaluate evidence, reasoning, and arguments
statement: I can evaluate evidence, reasoning, and arguments to reach a warranted judgment.

name: Think flexibly
statement: I can consider multiple perspectives and revise my thinking when the evidence warrants.

name: Monitor and improve my reasoning
statement: I can monitor my reasoning and take steps to improve it.

name: Solve Everyday and Real-World Problems
statement: I can understand a problem, work toward the best solution while weighing its impact, test and improve it when I can, and reflect on my solution and what I learned.

name: Understand the problem
statement: I can understand what a problem really is before trying to solve it.

name: Choose an approach
statement: I can choose a problem-solving approach that fits the problem.

name: Develop, Test, and Improve Prototypes (When Appropriate)
statement: I can develop, test, and improve prototypes when the problem calls for it.

name: Implement, evaluate, and reflect
statement: I can implement my solution, evaluate how well it worked, and reflect on what I learned.

name: Create and Innovate
statement: I can generate original ideas, develop and refine them into finished work, identify opportunities to create value for others, and turn promising ideas into action.

name: Generate original ideas
statement: I can generate many and varied ideas, and combine, adapt, or build on ideas to create something new.

name: Develop and refine creative work
statement: I can develop an idea into finished creative work, using critique and revision to strengthen its originality and craft.

name: Identify opportunities and create value
statement: I can identify unmet needs or opportunities and develop ideas that create social, cultural, or economic value for others.

name: Turn ideas into action
statement: I can launch a venture, product, event, or initiative by organizing people and resources, weighing risks and rewards, and planning how to reach the people it serves.

name: Engage as an Informed and Responsible Global Citizen
statement: I can explain how people, communities, and systems are interconnected, investigate issues across perspectives, and use what I learn to participate in civic and global life.

name: Explain global interconnections
statement: I can explain how local choices and global social, economic, political, and environmental systems influence one another.

name: Participate in civic and democratic life
statement: I can explain how government works at the local, state, and national levels, including my rights and responsibilities, and use that knowledge to participate in civic and democratic processes.

name: Examine global issues and perspectives
statement: I can investigate global issues using evidence and perspectives from different places and people affected.

name: Analyze how the past shapes the present
statement: I can analyze primary and secondary sources in their historical context to explain causes, changes, and continuities, and how the past shapes present-day communities and issues.

name: Make Ethical and Responsible Choices
statement: I can weigh values, perspectives, and consequences when making choices that affect other people, communities, and the world, and act with integrity.

name: Reason through ethical dilemmas
statement: I can weigh competing values, responsibilities, and consequences to make and explain ethical choices.

name: Weigh the impact of my choices
statement: I can analyze how my choices affect people, communities, and the environment, now and in the future, and use that analysis to guide what I do.

name: Use technology and AI ethically and responsibly
statement: I can use digital technologies and AI responsibly by protecting privacy, crediting others' work, identifying bias and potential harm, and deciding when and how to use these tools.

name: Act with integrity
statement: I can act on my values when it is difficult, take responsibility for the impact of my actions, and take steps to make things right.

name: Apply Academic Knowledge and Skills
statement: I can read complex texts critically, analyze quantitative data, model with mathematics, develop and use models, investigate scientific questions, apply core disciplinary concepts in new situations, and strengthen my academic skills.

name: Read critically and make meaning of complex texts
statement: I can read and analyze literary, informational, and subject-specific texts to understand ideas, evaluate arguments, and support interpretations with textual evidence.

name: Analyze and interpret quantitative data
statement: I can organize, represent, analyze, and interpret quantitative data to identify patterns, evaluate claims, and draw supported conclusions.

name: Model with mathematics
statement: I can use algebraic and other mathematical concepts, procedures, and representations (such as expressions, equations, inequalities, functions, and geometric figures) to represent real-world situations, solve problems, and interpret my results in context.

name: Develop and use models
statement: I can develop, use, and refine models to represent real-world situations, explain relationships, make predictions, and evaluate how well the models represent reality.

name: Use scientific inquiry and reasoning
statement: I can investigate scientific questions, gather and analyze evidence, and use scientific reasoning and core science concepts to develop and evaluate explanations.

name: Strengthen academic skills and prepare for assessments
statement: I can identify areas for growth in my reading and math skills, use effective study and test-taking strategies and online learning programs, track my growth, and use assessment results to strengthen my academic performance and test scores.

name: Use digital and AI tools to learn and work
statement: I can choose and use digital and AI tools, including tools used in my field of interest, to learn, investigate ideas, and produce quality work, checking the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.

name: Plan and Navigate My Postsecondary Future
statement: I can explore opportunities that align with my interests, strengths, and goals, make informed decisions about my future, and take steps toward my chosen pathway, including managing my money and navigating new settings.

name: Explore my interests, strengths, and possibilities
statement: I can connect my interests, strengths, and goals to possible education, training, career, and life pathways.

name: Investigate postsecondary and career pathways
statement: I can research the requirements, costs, earnings, and job outlook of different pathways after high school, including college, apprenticeship, military, employment, and self-employment.

name: Evaluate options and make informed choices
statement: I can compare possible pathways using my goals, values, opportunities, and constraints to make informed choices.

name: Plan and take steps toward my future
statement: I can develop and carry out a plan for my next steps after high school, including coursework, work-based learning, credentials, continued learning, deadlines, and needed resources.

name: Navigate new settings
statement: I can learn the expectations, rights, responsibilities, and supports in a new workplace, college, or training setting and use them to succeed and advocate for myself.

name: Manage my money
statement: I can build and follow a budget and make informed decisions about earning, saving, spending, borrowing, and paying for education or training.

name: Communicate my competencies, experiences, and goals
statement: I can communicate my competencies, experiences, skills, and goals effectively in applications, interviews, portfolios, and other postsecondary opportunities.

name: Curate my portfolio
statement: I can select, organize, and reflect on evidence of my competencies and experiences to show my growth and readiness.

name: Present and defend my portfolio
statement: I can present my portfolio to an audience, explain what my evidence shows about my growth and readiness, and respond to questions about it.

name: Craft my application materials
statement: I can create a resume, cover letter, personal statement, or online career profile tailored to a specific opportunity that shows why I am a strong fit.

name: Interview with confidence
statement: I can prepare for and participate in interviews, answering questions with specific examples of my experiences and competencies, and follow up afterward.

name: Identify and secure references
statement: I can identify people who know my work and character, ask them for references or recommendations, and keep them informed.

name: Communicate across workplace and community settings
statement: I can communicate by email, phone, video, and in person in ways that fit the relationship, purpose, and setting, including workplaces, colleges, and community organizations.

name: Manage my digital footprint and online presence
statement: I can build and manage an online presence that represents me the way I intend to employers, colleges, and communities.
